## Census Tracts

```{r Plot Manhattan Census Tracts}
#| code-summary: "Leaflet Census Tract Map - Manhattan County"
#| code-line-numbers: "|1-4|6-7|9-11|13-17"

# Download data using our helper function
download_data(
  url = "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/TRACT/tl_2025_36_tract.zip",
  relative_dir = "census/TIGER2025/TRACT")

# Read Shapefile
census_tracts  <- read_sf("./data_mid/census/TIGER2025/TRACT/tl_2025_36_tract.shp")

# Filter to Manhattan County (061)
new_york_county_tracts <- census_tracts %>%
  filter(STATEFP == "36", COUNTYFP == "061")

# Plot Leaflet Map
new_york_county_tracts %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(weight = 0.5, opacity = 1.0)
```
  
::: {.notes}
- Counties are broken into Census tracts
- About 85,000 nationally
- 5,411 in New York

:::
